Title: Update your Traffic Analytics queries by 31 August 2022

Body.Content:
The Log schema of the data generated by Traffic Analytics has been updated to simplify queries. These new fields provide information about source and destination IPs.

  • SrcPublicIPs_s
  • DestPublicIPs_s
  • NSGRule_s

As the new fields provide more efficient queries, we’re retiring the following older fields below by 31 August 2022.

  • VMIP_s
  • Subscription_g
  • Region_s
  • NSGRules_s
  • Subnet_s, VM_s
  • NIC_s
  • PublicIPs_s
  • FlowCount_d

How does this affect me?

After 31 August 2022, the retired fields will no longer be supported. Start using the new fields to simplify the query search and gather the data generated by Traffic Analytics. Learn more here.

If you have a support plan and need technical support, please contact us.
